claude_proposed_widenings.name: magic_item_spawn_placement_nearest_to_item
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The spawned-creature family can express only a coarse range header, not placement in the nearest unoccupied space relative to the item.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: The elemental appears in an unoccupied space as close to the censer as possible.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: catalog_ref_understands_summoner_languages
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Catalog-ref summons cannot carry deterministic summon-side overrides like inherited language comprehension.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: optional_creature_control_range_and_fallback
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: CreatureControl currently forces commandRangeFeet and defaultBehavior even when the rules text leaves both implicit, which required conservative placeholders here.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: obeys your commands, and takes its turn immediately after you on your Initiative count.
